recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Re-adding the exact DSTU2 on-target/ahead-of-target/behind-target codes to Goal.lifecycleStatus would reverse FHIR-17756's split; changing the current status-reason value set back to the FHIR-10023 example codes would conflict with FHIR-10615 and FHIR-44978.
issue_request: FHIR-10023 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Patient Care request for the Goal resource. It asked to represent goal progress by adding on-target, ahead-of-target, and behind-target to the then-current Goal status value set, and to add Goal.statusReason as a 0..* CodeableConcept with an example set including not-attainable and barrier reasons.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by eda8809625 ([#10023] Updated goal status codes, and goal.statusReason cardinality and value set for goal.statusReason), which added the requested progress codes to the old Goal status spreadsheet source and added the requested status-reason codes.
additional_context: Goal is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini. Later published/applied decisions changed how the same semantics are represented: FHIR-17756 split the old Goal.status into Goal.lifecycleStatus and Goal.achievementStatus, moving progress/achievement semantics out of lifecycle status; FHIR-10615 removed the original FHIR-specific status-reason value set by changing statusReason to string; FHIR-44978 then restored statusReason as 0..* CodeableConcept with a SNOMED example value set; and FHIR-53981 renamed statusReason to lifecycleStatusReason.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current authoritative StructureDefinition has Goal.achievementStatus bound to GoalAchievementStatus and Goal.lifecycleStatusReason as 0..* CodeableConcept with an example GoalStatusReason binding, so reintroducing the original DSTU2 Goal.status/statusReason shape would conflict with later final decisions.

related_jiras.note: Early cleanup of the old Goal.status hierarchy after FHIR-10023, before the later lifecycle/achievement split.
Changed Goal.statusReason away from the original FHIR-specific example value set.
Split Goal.status into lifecycleStatus and achievementStatus, superseding the old placement of progress codes in Goal.status.
Clarified that statusDate applied to achievement status and statusReason to lifecycle status.
Made Goal.statusReason 0..* CodeableConcept with a SNOMED example binding.
Renamed statusReason to lifecycleStatusReason and statusDate to achievementStatusDate.
